subject: release-tooling/regex-replacement-escaping
statement: When release/recovery tooling structurally rewrites source with `re.sub`/`re.subn`, use a callable replacement whenever replacement text can contain backslashes or escape sequences. Do not pass generated source snippets with escapes as regex replacement strings, because replacement-string escape semantics can corrupt source.
